context: Asuka lectures on how public policy is decided.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: civics lecture; civic vocabulary (公共/推進/規制/審議/大統領) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 公共の政策は、慎重に審議されます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 審議は、誰が行うんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 議会で、長く審議されます。
lines.en: It's deliberated at length in parliament.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 規制は、どう決まるんですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 規制は、公共の安全のために作られます。
lines.en: Regulations are made for public safety.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大統領制の国では、違うんですか?
lines.en: Is it different in presidential nations?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大統領が、政策の推進を主導します。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 公共の推進と規制、両方が要るんですね。
lines.en: Both public promotion and regulation are needed.
lines.style: understanding adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
